items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: when Johnny left we sent to Kansas City and got one of the Douglas brothers.

ctx.x: So I saw him come back stage and I said, 'Now, something is funny here because Johnny's leaving,' and Sonny Greer was gone with Johnny and Lawrence left to go with Johnny. So they didn't send all the way back to New York for a trombone player, they sent to Los Angeles because it was close to Frisco and got Britt Woodman. And at that time Claude Jones had came back. He had came back to the band, but Jones was juicing again -- and we went to go out to the microphone to play 'Mood Indigo' and Jones knocked over a…

So we went on to the Oasis, the club in Frisco -- and, by the way, when Johnny left we sent to Kansas City and got one of the Douglas brothers. They were saxophone players in Kansas City, good saxophone players, but it wasn't really what Duke wanted.
And we had Charlie Smith come out to play drums.
